working: Facial and meridional isomerism occurs in octahedral complexes of the type MA3B3. [Cr(py)3Cl3] is of this type, so it shows fac and mer isomers. [Cr(H2O)6]3+ is MA6 and has no geometrical isomers. [Co(NH3)4(H2O)2]3+ is MA4B2 and shows only cis/trans isomerism. [Ni(en)2(H2O)2]2+ is M(AA)2B2 and also shows only cis/trans isomerism.
